newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's Dolenjska banka to list more shares.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's Dolenjska banka to list more shares.

text.p: Slovenian bank Dolenjska banka said on Friday it would list an additional 13,000 ordinary shares, representing five percent of its equity, on the primary market of the Ljubljana bourse on Monday.
Following the move, the bank will have listed all its equity on the exchange.
The shares to be listed will join 172,802 ordinary shares that were floated in March, when the bank also listed 78,743 preferred shares.
The nominal value of all shares is 8,000 tolars.

On Friday morning, the listed ordinary shares of Dolenjska banka rose 4.2 percent to 11,790 tolars, while preferred shares, currently standing at 11,000 tolars, were not traded. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
